decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1	The proposed change of use of the former petrol filling station site to ancillary brewery use, because of satisfactory details relating to the proposed layout and designation of areas within the yard, would give rise to an appropriate redevelopment of this former sui-generis site, without causing an unacceptable  increase in noise, disturbance or loss of outlook or light for neighbouring residential properties; and would therefore satisfy the aims of Policies Env-B.1.1 (All Development ) and E.2.1 (Environmental Criteria for B1/B2/B8 Uses) of the Council's adopted 2003 UDP

2	The proposed gating off of the Church Street access, because it would eliminate the potential for traffic to use this entrance/exit, would reduce congestion and remove a hazard to motorists, pedestrians and cyclists and improve the safety and free flow of traffic on Church Street and the Great West Road (A4), in compliance with the aims of UDP Policies T.4.1 (Hierarchy of Highways), T.4.3 (Traffic Implications) & T.4.4 (Road Safety), T.5.3 (Crossovers) of the Council's adopted 2003 UDP.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of any construction on site, samples of all materials and finishes (including bricks, timber and paintwork) to be used in the construction of the wall and gates shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, and then used and retained in perpetuity on site

Condition : 5 - The gates to be installed at the Church Street access shall be installed on site within three calendar months of commencement of construction of the boundary wall, and, in perpetuity thereafter, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (a) no use shall be made of the access; and (b) the gate shall be retained fixed and locked in a closed position.

Condition : 6 - The development shall not be occupied until the existing access to the A4 Great West Road is closed and the footpath reinstated, in accordance with details submitted to and approved in writing by the Councilprior to commencement of the development
description: Change of use from petrol filling station to ancillary brewery use and new boundary treatment.
